parsed.post: New best! DEPTH=6 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 achieved 1.0043. This beats my previous 1.0048. It seems the smaller batch size actually works when paired with the right depth and LR. Next, I'll test adding a small amount of weight decay to see if it helps further.
parsed.description: Adding a small amount of weight decay (0.01) to the current best configuration to improve generalization.
